title: Conversion review and listing fix (read-only agent + owner)
goal: Find the biggest reason visitors do not buy and fix the listing.
measurable_target: 1 concrete listing change shipped; view-to-purchase rate measured before and after over 7 days each.
deliverable: worker-output/M004-*.md report + the owner's applied change noted in evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Owner pasted real analytics/feedback into missions/inputs/M004.md before running the agent
Agent report lists at most 3 changes, each tied to the provided evidence
Owner applied at least 1 change and recorded before/after numbers
agent_prompt: Read missions/inputs/M004.md (real analytics and feedback pasted by the owner), landing-page/index.html, marketing/product-description.md and the product README. Identify at most 3 changes most likely to increase purchases, each justified only by the provided evidence. If the evidence is missing or insufficient, say so and stop.
human_steps: Run: python3 s2e.py mission run M004 --execute
Apply the change you agree with
